newsitem.title: CANADA: ATHLETICS-BAILEY WINS SPRINT SHOWDOWN AS JOHNSON COMES UP LAME.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BAILEY WINS SPRINT SHOWDOWN AS JOHNSON COMES UP LAME.

text.p: World 100 meters record holder Donovan Bailey of Canada defeated 200 meters world record holder Michael Johnson in their 150-meter sprint showdown on Sunday as the U.S. Olympic champion pulled up lame.
Bailey, who was leading Johnson around the curve when Johnson quit in pain, clocked an unofficial 14.99 seconds to pocket a $1 million prize.
Both sprinters had already been assured appearance fees of $500,000 each.
